meta.description: Small, partial correspondence table between the repealed and the new Indian criminal codes (IPC->BNS, CrPC->BNSS, Evidence Act->BSA).
meta.warning: NOT COMPLETE AND NOT VERIFIED. Every entry is unverified and must be checked against the official Gazette / India Code text before research use. Sections were split, merged and renumbered, so one-to-one correspondence is not guaranteed; sub-section numbers in `new` are given where the main punishment clause is meant.
